description: Scanning the minimal-agent-skills fixture detects exactly one `skill` node at the open-standard path `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with no issues. `agent-skills` is experimental (ships disabled) and gated by the active lens, so the fixture's `settings.json` both enables `agent-skills/agent-skills` and pins `activeProvider: agent-skills`; under its own lens the provider classifies the file as `provider: agent-skills, kind: skill` rather than falling through to the universal `core/markdown` fallback.
